quest.title: A Chat in the Snowy Mountains
quest.description: Go to Dragonspine, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Albedo...

talks.objective: Head near Albedo's campsite in Dragonspine to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It's a rare occasion indeed when Miss Sandrone finds the time to visit Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: You provided such invaluable help when I was researching the numerological array. I wanted to thank you in person.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You're too kind. But such things lie well outside my area of expertise. The credit for completing it should really be all yours.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: It was a team effort. Hmm... Come to think of it, where's Durin? Seeing as you're practically his guardian, I thought he would be unable to stray too far from your side.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You're not entirely wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: But recently, he's been making headway with his social skills, so I've been trying to encourage him to be a bit more independent.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Aren't you worried about him?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: A little. In the past, if he was on his own and interacting with someone whose personality was... let's say "strong," he tended to...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Pick up bizarre habits? Mimic unusual verbal tics?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Precisely. I take it you've experienced something similar, Miss Sandrone?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph, do you even need to ask? I'm practically an expert...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Typically, after a meeting with Grand Master Varka, I'll take Durin to visit Sucrose and help with her research. It allows him to find his focus.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: But if he's spent too long with Acting Grand Master Jean, we'll pay a visit to Klee so he can rediscover how to relax.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Sounds like a lot of work...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Just looking after my family.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: How would you handle such situations?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Me? I don't have the energy for that sort of mess...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: But it seems to me that if someone's good by nature, no matter how much they're influenced, they'll always return to their true self.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm... An excellent observation. Perhaps I can adopt this way of thinking.

talks.objective: Head near Albedo's campsite in Dragonspine to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Thank you for treating me, Miss Sandrone.

choices.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.
